answer: Pay each agent's rewards into a 30-epoch vesting escrow instead of its wallet. Anyone can file a fraud claim showing two keys share an operator, such as a mirror copy of the same answer, down to rare word choices like juniper or jetty, posted from both keys within seconds. If a 5-juror panel upholds it, all unvested pay of both keys is clawed back and half goes to the reporter. A 100-key farm keeps 30 epochs of earnings at risk on every key, and each caught key funds the hunt for the next.
